newsitem.title: SWEDEN: Pharmacia edges up amid nervous trade.
newsitem.headline: Pharmacia edges up amid nervous trade.

text.p: Shares in Swedish/U.S. drugs group Pharmacia were trading slightly higher on Thursday although dealers said the market was still extremely nervous over the stock after the firm's latest profit warning.
Pharmacia plunged on Wednesday to close 39 crowns down at 230 after saying its first quarter sales would be six percent lower and its EPS would also drop.
By 0900 GMT, it had made a small gain of four crowns to 230 crowns with more than 800,000 shares traded after slipping to a low of 226 crowns in initial trade.
Dealers said the slight rise was caused by some short-covering and bargain-hunting.
They said the market remained edgy and was waiting for first quarter figures on Tuesday next week for more details on the company's prospects.
"There is a wait and see attitude," one trader said. "The market is nervous."
